people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
translations.bsb: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.
translations.kjv: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
translations.asv: Brethren, my heart's desire and my supplication to God is for them, that they may be saved.
